newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ITALY'S LOMBARDO MOVES TO PALACE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ITALY'S LOMBARDO MOVES TO PALACE.

text.p: Crystal Palace said on Friday they had signed Italy winger Attilio Lombardo from Juventus for an undisclosed fee.
The newly-promoted English club's manager Steve Coppell confirmed the signing to the Palace clubline service, which called it "the biggest transfer deal in Palace history".
Media reports last week talked of a 2.1 million pounds ($3.5 million) transfer before it appeared to collapse over wage demands and a misunderstanding over net and gross pay.
However, Coppell said any problems had been resolved at talks with the 31-year-old player in London on Thursday.
"We've agreed the basis of a deal and its now subject to a medical," Coppell said. "We've agreed terms with Juventus so its all go-ahead now.
Coppell said Juventus had "come down in their demands and Attilio bent our way and made it clear he does want to play in the premier league.
"He'll give us a little bit of class, a little bit of guile that we may have been missing.
Lombardo helped Juventus win the serie A title last season and played for Italy in the recent Tournoi de France.
Palace also announced that former England midfielder Ray Wilkins had joined the club as an assistant first team coach.
